root_completeness_detail: skills/review/SKILL.md read whole (341 lines); confirming bounded read at offset 342 returned the reader's shorter-than-offset report. First candidate <repo-root>/skills/review resolved; no candidate advanced past.

phase3_findings.description: AC6 unmet: the PR touches no docs/ file, so none of the five added instruments is documented in runtime-evaluations.md. lint-internal-docs.py passing does not discharge the documentation clause.

The diff-added _floor_merge_key_staged header names lib/test/run.sh as the site pinning the two existing copies' breadcrumbs; the pins are in lib/test/modules/efficiency-trace-telemetry.sh and run.sh carries none.
A diff-added test comment says 'four sub-fields' while the assertion two lines below pins five and the shipped jq object builds five.

prepare-harness-floor.sh passes $CANDIDATE to _emit unsanitized on the issue-number-unusable branch; the emitted line is eval'd by both workflows. A single quote in the value breaks out of the quoting. Reproduced against HEAD.
The diff-modified _emit header asserts 'all four are sanitized to a fixed shape before this is called'; operand 3 is not sanitized, so the comment asserts the exact invariant that is missing.

The new mixed-store assertion is vacuous: actionable-patterns.sh overwrites the inherited EXPERIMENTS_FILE and dies on an unbound $2 when --full is passed as $1, so both invocations yield 0 warnings by construction. It counts toward the 165->167 floor bump.
The timeline fixture is labelled a 'production-realistic captured transcript' but is synthesized inline from the file's own constructors; AC5 asks specifically for a captured fixture.

load_runs() swallows every OSError, so an unreadable or absent store is reported as 'no runs yet'; DEFAULT_STORE is also cwd-relative, diverging from the repo-root config contract. The retrospective's || guard cannot fire because the script exits 0.

The union-merge reduce list omits issue_number and no_pr_reason, which apply_pr_less_issue_floor writes, while the diff-added comment beside it claims every floor key is re-applied. The new test pins the literal instead of reconciling the set against the floors.

withholding_reasons() gates on the raw cohort size while every statistic is computed over numeric(durations); a five-run cohort with four unmeasured durations passes and prints a verdict from a one-sample mean.
phase_shares() divides by the sum of established durations only, so an unestablished phase is given zero share and the rest inflate to 100% with nothing marking the run as partial.
prepare-run-profile.sh's success path and four of its failure arms have no coverage; a break there silently produces an empty DEVFLOW_RUN_PROFILE while every asserted arm stays green.
The three-arm workflow selection wiring the glue to its consumer is untested inline YAML shell; both ends of the seam are covered but the wiring is not.
The ENABLED!=true arm of both new floors is uncovered while both pre-existing floors' identical arms are asserted — the off-switch-that-never-worked bug class.

The changeset claims 'four new maintainer instruments read it' but names three, and implement-timeline.py reads the transcript artifact rather than the per-run record. This text ships to consumers via CHANGELOG.md.
prepare-run-profile.sh discards the deriver's stderr and reports 'could not parse the workpad' for every cause, contradicting its own header contract that each branch names which condition fired.
Corrupt store lines are dropped with no count, so every aggregate shrinks invisibly; the sibling parser added in the same PR reports its skips.
The retrospective appends with >> and sends the failure diagnostic to the agent's stderr, so a truncated section reaches the posted report with no indication of failure.
UNESTABLISHED is an untyped str unioned into numeric fields; every guard is conventional rather than type-level.
An empty --cohort-a/--cohort-b prefix-matches every run, so an empty operand can select the whole store as both cohorts.
_iter_records' tuple conflates a per-record payload with a stream-level aggregate, and its docstring omits the terminating (None, skipped) sentinel build_timeline depends on.
_top_phases runs Path(p).name over workpad phase headings, which are never paths.
regressions() compares against the four preceding populated weeks, not the four preceding calendar weeks.
engine_outcome and prior_record_count are loaded on every record and read by nothing, and are the two fields whose union type is never guarded.
derive() returns an established empty map when the Progress block parses but holds no recognized phase, conflating that with durations having been established.
Three added comment blocks run 11-18 lines and are largely derivation and provenance rather than the wrong change they prevent; the checked-in 2390-records figure will rot.
The new module arms are guarded by if [ -x ... ], which fails open under an exact assertion floor — a lost executable bit reports a count mismatch rather than a named skip.
render_runs' status column is 12 wide but the sentinel it most often holds, unestablished, is 13 characters.
download_transcript classifies stderr before checking the exit status, so a successful download whose output mentions a marker phrase is raised as a failure.
errors='replace' silently substitutes undecodable bytes, which then surface as a generic unparseable-record count naming two causes, neither the actual one.
The run-profile floor's merge arm drops an unreadable telemetry blob with a bare || continue and no breadcrumb, unlike every other arm in both new floors.
_load_workpad's stated justification does not hold: the module already inserts its own directory on sys.path, so a plain import would resolve.

deviations: Phase 2 verification dispatched 11 group verifiers (grouped by source file) rather than one dispatch per item. All 69 agent items were verified and each has its own nonce-bound verdict file; no item was dropped or budget-narrowed.

Phase 1 batches were recovered from the generator agents' transcripts after their results did not arrive as notifications; the 81-item merge captured at Phase 1 close is the authoritative input the deduper consumed.

normalize-verdicts.py returned its bad-input report twice on the grouped-array shape; the verdicts were re-emitted as per-item nonce files and the third invocation took the results arm cleanly (needs_retry empty).
